versions.notes: SevenCode 1.0.27 — one Node bundle (3 475 382 bytes, sha256 91311f19a31f80196e36e32bcd217e745048ecf33d08f0bca61b3e70aedec5d1), so one artefact serves every platform; the layer is executable by the file mode it carries. Not the npm build of the same name, which speaks a different surface (spec/25). The artefact sits behind a login and the digest decides whether it may run: a token opens the door, it does not vouch for the bytes. Whoever has no token for this GitLab points COVEY_ENGINE_CATALOG_URL at a catalogue of their own — the engine is then an image question, as it was before this document.
